scope: 15 unique canonical units, 30 grade IDs after CKPT-140; original 568 contextual documentation not repeated
method: Same-assistant domain/source/linguistic counterexamples with explicitly labeled source access; original QABC copied read-only from master
evidence_gate: NO OFFICIAL EXAM KEY OR EDITION AUTHORIZATION; never mark learner-approved

original_options.A: numai un câmp de curenţi de conducţie în regim staţionar

cards.technical_precheck: C is plausible only if 'câmp de inducţie electromagnetică' means magnetic induction B with div(B)=0.

abc_scope_analysis.A: conduction-current electric field is not automatically source-free.
abc_scope_analysis.B: electric field may have charge sources.
abc_scope_analysis.C: magnetic B is solenoidal, but original terminology is not identical.

original_options.A: eliminarea totală a posibilităţii apariţiei unui scurtcircuit între faze;
original_options.B: micşorarea riscului unor pierderi de gaz izolant;
original_options.C: reducerea cheltuielilor de realizare a instalaţiilor.

cards.technical_precheck: Single-phase enclosed GIS separates phases internally, but 'total elimination' of phase-phase faults across the full installation is unproven.

abc_scope_analysis.A: word 'totală' exceeds evidence for terminals and external interconnections.
abc_scope_analysis.B: leakage depends on compartment joints/design; not intrinsically reduced.
abc_scope_analysis.C: costs vary by equipment and installation.

cards.question_original: Ce posibilităţi de limitare a curenţilor de scurtcirciut sunt de preferat pentru schema de mai sus ?

original_options.A: reducerea t.e.m., acţionând asupra circuitului de excitaţie al generatorului;
original_options.B: mărirea reactanţei schemei de alimentare între sursă şi locul de defect;
original_options.C: creşterea capacităţii de rupere a întreruptoarelor.

cards.technical_precheck: Increasing source-to-fault reactance lowers prospective short-circuit current in the simple Thevenin model; the question's referenced diagram is missing here.

abc_scope_analysis.A: excitation control can alter generator contribution but not established for the omitted scheme.
abc_scope_analysis.C: breaker breaking capacity is interruption capability, not a direct reduction in prospective fault current.

cards.question_original: Curentul electric alternativ poate fi produs numai prin fenomene:
cards.technical_precheck: Electromagnetic induction is a standard method of generating AC in an alternator, not the only way to produce an AC output.

abc_scope_analysis.A: thermal phenomena alone do not specify alternation.
abc_scope_analysis.B: electrochemical DC may feed electronics but is not sufficient alone.
abc_scope_analysis.C: exam intended induction, refuted as exclusive by DC-to-AC power electronic inverter.

cards.question_original: Curentul din circuitul statoric al unui generator crește direct proporţional:
cards.technical_precheck: For balanced sinusoidal three-phase: I=sqrt(P²+Q²)/(sqrt(3)*U), which refutes unqualified direct proportionality to U or only P or generally Q.

abc_scope_analysis.A: at constant P,Q I varies inversely with U.
abc_scope_analysis.C: at fixed P,U, I depends on magnitude Q but is not linear in Q except special cases.

cards.question_original: Dacă două conductoare parcurse de curenţi în acelaşi sens sunt aşezate paralel, unul lângă altul:

original_options.A: densitatea de curent crește în părţile apropiate ale conductoarelor
original_options.B: densitatea de curent creşte în părţile mai depărtate ale conductoarelor
original_options.C: densitatea de curent este uniformă pe ambele părţi ale conductoarelor

cards.technical_precheck: For adjacent AC conductors with equal-direction currents, proximity effect tends to crowd current toward outer faces; no AC frequency is stated.

abc_scope_analysis.A: inward crowding pertains other current orientations.
abc_scope_analysis.B: supported for the AC proximity-effect regime, but not universally for DC.
abc_scope_analysis.C: only as ideal DC/neglecting skin and proximity.

cards.question_original: Două funcţii periodice sinusoidale sunt armonice între ele dacă:

original_options.A: raportul perioadelor lor este un număr întreg oarecare
original_options.C: raportul perioadelor lor este egal cu 1/2

cards.technical_precheck: Sinusoids are harmonically related when one frequency is an integer multiple of a fundamental. The 'ratio of periods' order and unique-option logic are unspecified.

abc_scope_analysis.A: ratio integer works when properly oriented; can be 1 too.
abc_scope_analysis.B: identical periods produce same frequency, a 1:1 special case.
abc_scope_analysis.C: period ratio 1/2 corresponds to twice the frequency and is also harmonic in the usual sense.

cards.question_original: Fluxul electric total, produs de o sarcină electrică de valoare q printr-o suprafaţă închisă care o înconjoară, este egal cu:
cards.technical_precheck: Gauss flux through a closed surface depends on whether flux of D or of E is meant; Romanian prior research uses D.

abc_scope_analysis.B: q for closed flux ∮D·dS=q in electrotechnical terminology.
abc_scope_analysis.C: q/2 unsupported. For E in vacuum, OpenStax has ∮E·dS=q/eps0, not q.

cards.question_original: Forţa care se exercită asupra unui conductor rectiliniu, parcurs de curentul i, aflat în câmpul de inducţie magnetică B se numeşte:
cards.technical_precheck: The physical force on a current-carrying conductor in B obeys Laplace/Ampere F=I*l cross B; exact Romanian competing names require exact glossary.

abc_scope_analysis.B: 'electrodynamic' may be a broader term in some literature and is not excluded without glossary.
abc_scope_analysis.C: magnetomotive force denotes NI, not mechanical force.

cards.question_original: Împărţirea fiecărei faze a unei instalaţii capsulate într-un anumit număr de compartimente atrage după sine:

original_options.A: limitarea posibilităţilor de producere a unui defect în instalaţie;
original_options.B: mărirea riscului de producere a unor scăpări de gaz;
original_options.C: mărirea cantităţilor de gaz ce trebuie manipulate în cazul intervenţiei la un compartiment.

cards.technical_precheck: GIS gas partitioning limits fault extent and service continuity impact; it does not necessarily reduce the likelihood a fault starts.

abc_scope_analysis.B: added seals could introduce leakage opportunities but needs design-specific risk.
abc_scope_analysis.C: compartment service ordinarily manipulates less gas than opening entire vessel, contrary to claim.

cards.question_original: În cazul scăderii sau întreruperii tensiunii de alimentare, motoarele asincrone se pot opri, iar la restabilirea tensiunii:

original_options.A: ele autopornesc, indiferent de tipul constructiv al rotorului în scurtcircuit
original_options.B: pentru a reporni necesită dispozitiv de pornire
original_options.C: ele autopornesc numai dacă au rotor în dublă colivie

cards.technical_precheck: Self-restart after voltage recovery depends on starter logic, under-voltage protection, contactor and load; rotor type is not the sole determinant.

abc_scope_analysis.A: 'indiferent' ignores restart interlock and control supply.
abc_scope_analysis.B: manual re-start may be required under some starter arrangements, not all.
abc_scope_analysis.C: double-cage rotor is not a necessary condition of restart.

cards.question_original: În echipamentul electric, uleiul electroizolant, din punct de vedere electric:

original_options.A: asigură doar izolarea părților sub tensiune între ele si fatã de masã
original_options.B: stinge arcul electric care apare in întrerupătoare

cards.technical_precheck: Oil is used for insulation and, in an oil circuit-breaker, arc extinction; the question does not identify exact equipment.

abc_scope_analysis.B: true for an oil circuit breaker but not function of oil in every electrical apparatus.
abc_scope_analysis.C: mechanical lubrication is not main electrical function.

cards.question_original: În sens general, actualizarea unui fond reprezintă:

original_options.A: calculul valorii acestui fond la un anumit an ales ca referinţă;
original_options.B: calculul valorii acestui fond la N ani înainte de PIF;
original_options.C: calculul valorii acestui fond la N ani după PIF.

cards.technical_precheck: In financial discounting/accumulation, value is expressed at a selected reference date; relative PIF direction depends on reference.

abc_scope_analysis.B: an example before commissioning, not universal.
abc_scope_analysis.C: an example after commissioning, not universal.

cards.question_original: Temperatura înfăşurărilor statorice ale generatoarelor electrice este determinată:
cards.technical_precheck: Joule I²R losses heat stator windings, but steady winding temperature is also affected by cooling, ambient and iron/stray losses.

abc_scope_analysis.B: phase voltage can affect conditions but is not sole determinant.
abc_scope_analysis.C: Joule losses drive heating, not by themselves the absolute winding temperature.

cards.question_original: Într-o schemă electrică prevăzută cu mai multe sisteme de bare colectoare, separatorul de bare

original_options.A: asigură doar selectarea sistemului de bare pe care urmează a fi conectat circuitul;
original_options.B: asigură izolarea unei părţi a circuitului de bara colectoare aflată sub tensiune;
original_options.C: comutaţia curentului în regim normal de funcţionare.

cards.technical_precheck: Busbar disconnectors select/isolate circuits from the live bus under proper off-load conditions; they are not load-breaking circuit breakers.

abc_scope_analysis.A: 'doar selectarea' is too exclusive if isolation function counted.
abc_scope_analysis.B: identifies separation/isolation function but requires topology and de-energized switching conditions.
abc_scope_analysis.C: cannot routinely interrupt normal load current as a disconnector.
